snippet.title: Strong Bad's Cool Game for Attractive People: Episode 1 - Homestar Ruiner [Full Episode]
snippet.description:
Subscribe to watch more videos! ►
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCHGfuSEWl_xngWJDKD0-GgQ?sub_confirmation=1

Another hidden gem from Telltale Games.
I never heard of Homestar Runner for the longest time and it wasn't until I saw the video 'GTA has Multiplayer' that I first saw a character reference of Strong Bad. Maybe a year later I started playing Poker Night at the Inventory and one of the card players was Strong Bad and I liked his character a lot so I bought all of the Strong Bad episodes on Steam while there was a sale and I don't regret it.
